method.limits: Features, release/change evidence, licenses and at least two concrete source bodies per resolved repository sampled. Skill repositories use instruction assets as executable workflow source, not falsely characterized as product code. Upstream test/benchmark claims not independently run.
method.cleanRoom: No clean-room claim. Reading source then rewriting does not establish independent clean-room separation. Any actual reuse needs applicable file/asset terms and notices; copyleft is not an automatic prohibition.
method.council: Independent domain reports followed by one cross-domain critique; Root decisions preserve disagreement and existing product ownership, not unanimous correctness.

decisions.owner: Root / existing connector and effect owners
decisions.title: Connector outcomes and outbound draft revisions
decisions.scope: Begin with a gap case in email sink recovery, then extend the existing receipt/cursor owner. Unit key includes connector/account/item/revision/input hash. States committed, retryable, terminal_failure, unknown_outcome remain distinct. Explicit per-tool atomic-or-partial batch policy. Optional publication drafts bind destination rendition, payload revision and existing approval.
acceptance: Prove a currently missing case before changing existing admission; no duplicate canonical owner.
Crash after external success/before receipt never blindly retries an indeterminate effect; reconcile provider evidence or require replan.
One failed unit cannot erase successful receipts or mark the whole scan complete.
Same idempotency key/different destination, content or grant conflicts; changed rendition requires current approval.
Reserved connector/daemon metadata cannot be overridden by model payload.

decisions.owner: Root / existing council, recipe and replay owners
decisions.title: Evidence-bound workflow handoffs and comparable trials
decisions.scope: An immutable contract sidecar binds workflow/version, inputs/config/corpus/skill hashes, declared effects, output schema and versioned verifier. Existing effect/WAL/replay paths own state. Compare curated run artifacts using existing parity provenance; do not equate contains-v1 with product correctness.
acceptance: Verifier outcome is verified/failed/inconclusive/not-run; missing, stale or foreign verifier evidence cannot admit dependent effect.
Only declared dependencies block, not unrelated work; artifact without independent verification is not fact.
Selective recovery lists preserved/rerun units and requires terminal source, exact contract/plan/input bindings plus effect receipts; otherwise needs_manual_replan.
Unknown external outcome never reruns automatically. Same reservation/budget owner persists through retry/cancel.
Comparable reports preserve both candidates, evaluator identity/version, criteria and config mismatches; no self-voted automatic policy/model promotion.

decisions.owner: Root / prompt assembly and existing cost owner
decisions.title: Prompt-component cost attribution
decisions.scope: Attach component identity/count metadata to existing reservation: system, workflow, skill, retrieval, tool result, user, unattributed. Retain provider/model/tokenizer/rate versions; capture at assembly, not MITM.
acceptance: No second precharge or billing owner.
Observed provider totals reconcile with attributed plus unattributed usage; estimates stay distinct and need not equal provider billing.
Missing usage remains unknown, including timeout after send; no raw prompt or secret leakage.
Repeated/reused prompt components are accounted under explicit cached/uncached rules where provider evidence exists.

decisions.owner: Root / current document staging, recall and lifecycle owners
decisions.title: Structure-preserving source projections and document lineage
decisions.scope: Add bounded source projections for headings/tables/lists/code and original ranges; logical document/revision/rename lineage follows the existing staging and source/claim/scope owner. Purge lineage includes derived projections; payload erasure and minimum audit metadata remain distinct.
acceptance: Same source and parser version yields deterministic bounded projection; oversized blocks follow explicit overflow policy instead of unbounded whole-table retention.
Every citation resolves to the exact source revision/range; moved/repeated equal blocks are not silently the same identity.
Cancellation never publishes a partial index as complete; rename does not replace content history.
Derived data deletion failures remain visible/retryable and cannot be declared erased prematurely.
Existing applied-once document claims and source/scope authority remain unchanged.

decisions.owner: Root / canonical companion daemon and Flutter projection
decisions.scope: Extend W2485 Jarvis/WhatsApp tool-call mobile port only where current companion lacks projection. Single daemon delivery/effect owner; client ID correlates to canonical event ID. Display pending/unknown/failed/confirmed faithfully, typed approvals/action cards and endpoint/environment rebind.
acceptance: Provider echo joins only proven message identity; identical text alone never deduplicates messages.
Disconnected mobile never labels unacknowledged mutation sent or resends an unknown outcome automatically.
Offline queue is a bounded projection/submission buffer with no independent effect/retry authority; reconnect revalidates canonical state.
Approval binds current tool/destination/payload revision; session/incognito/subject switches cannot leak previous state.
Endpoint/environment switch rejects stale credential binding; owner-authorized revocation remains possible.
Hosted contract/UI evidence then actual device acceptance separately; no .slint edits under current hold.

decisions.owner: Root / artifact export owner and optional approved remote renderer
decisions.scope: ExplanationArtifact for selected verified activity/architecture/source facts. Inert HTML/SVG export is default; interactive Anatomy rendering is a separately declared active-content mode. Preserve input/source hashes, model/renderer revision and illustrative/observed/derived labels. No renderer dependency for daemon startup.
acceptance: Export exactly selected approved facts; no illustrative geometry promoted to verification.
No external requests or arbitrary embedded input HTML/script in inert mode; redact before export.
Active renderer has explicit allowlisted assets, resource/deadline caps and isolated approved host; failure cannot mark artifact verified.
Output digest/source revisions retained before publication; accessible static fallback, keyboard/reduced motion where interactive.
BSOD hold: no local Node, browser or rendering. Current research is not installed-tool or rendered-artifact acceptance.

decisions.scope: Visible reversible explicit session/device presentation override, with preference precedence and compaction restoration inside the existing profile engine. Complements existing default-on adaptation; no second profile store.
acceptance: Explicit selection outranks inferred preference; off/reset is durable and visible.
Compaction/reconnect preserve declared scope without leaking across users/incognito.
Never infer ADHD/medical labels or change permissions/tool effects from presentation preference.
No arbitrary response-length cap copied from an upstream skill.

decisions.scope: Compare current Responses/provider adapter against explicit capability descriptors. Unsupported hosted tools, store:false, tool arguments/results, reasoning/redaction and cancellation must be represented honestly; no Strata engine dependency.
acceptance: Unsupported tool cannot silently drop and report success.
Store:false cannot be upgraded to durable remote storage.
Queue/cancel/unknown-terminal state remains typed; authority and source policies enforced by existing owner.
Only add regression for a demonstrated gap; no second inference server.

decisions.owner: Root / model evaluation research; no current compute dispatch
decisions.title: NEOTH-domain multi-agent trajectory training
decisions.scope: Potentially improve a trainable model used by NEOTH. First compare fixed-model task-specific handoff workflows against baseline. Only then a separately budgeted remote SFT/LoRA pilot using permitted model/data/training tools. No MASS-specific code copy without grant; no automatic model replacement.
acceptance: Preregister disjoint train/development/heldout task families, corpus hashes, objective checks, independent blinded judgments and quality/cost/latency thresholds before optimization.
Equal total inference/evaluation budget for workflow-only comparisons; report all trials, failures, confidence intervals and retained baseline, not only champions.
Training corpus consists of licensed/authorized curated or synthetic successful and failure/recovery trajectories; no automatic private WAL/chat harvesting or hidden reasoning extraction.
Measure task completion, tool/permission/side-effect correctness, recovery, retention of coding skills, total tokens/latency/cost including search/data generation/training.
New model wins defined NEOTH target tasks without violating effect authority or regressing required functions; otherwise retain baseline.
Record model/adapter/data/optimizer/evaluator provenance, checkpoint rollback and cancellation; isolated compute with fixed resource cap. No local workload under BSOD hold.
Question about benefit does not authorize paid GPU rental, production deployment or training run. Concrete compute/model selection and cost cap remain prerequisites.
